summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting, but did not run tests, mypy, or Black, per your instructions. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and Tuple[ControlType, str] to ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title) with a docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, checking only is_terminal. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title). Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only, mocked wrapper). CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Nothing is committed. Choices: the existing non-terminal control-drop logic in _render_buffer was left as is, and the console test uses legacy_windows=False and _environ={} like the neighbouring show_cursor test.
